acceptance_criteria: record-size and tag-validity boundary cases plus a crafted digest-valid out-of-contract recovery frame; CHK-06, NEG-04, NEG-05, NEG-31.
statement: A record whose encoded frame exceeds the declared maximum record size **shall** be rejected (`RecordTooLarge`) with no append, and a bounded target/tool tag that is empty, longer than the accepted `Tag` maximum, or non-printable **shall** be rejected (`RejectedConfiguration`) with no append. The same bounded-tag contract **shall** hold on recovery: a complete frame whose declared target/tool length exceeds `Tag::max_length`, or whose tag bytes are empty, NUL-containing, or non-printable, **shall** stop the scan with `CorruptRecord`, **shall** yield no recovered value, and **shall** not manufacture a false orphan.
title: T026 requirement 004
verification_intent: record-size and tag-validity boundary cases plus a crafted digest-valid out-of-contract recovery frame; CHK-06, NEG-04, NEG-05, NEG-31.
